# Rule 3.5 Full continuity of your character and the events that happen to them is expected. All rounds and the events that happened within them are considered canon unless otherwise stated by an admin. 
[color=lightgray]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/color] 

• You are allowed to recall past shifts in any manner unless it violates the New Life Rule. 

• Punishments you receive will be enforced and carried out in-character throughout rounds. If your character is demoted, you are expected to stay out of that job until a reasonable amount of time has passed, or you are re-hired again in-game. - [color=lightgray]This is considered a demotion or a suspension and is different from a job ban. It only applies to the character that received the demotion/suspension. - [color=lightgray]The default duration for this kind of punishment is four weeks. - [color=lightgray]This rule generally does not apply to being put in prison; however, you may choose to continue your sentence by choosing to join as a prisoner.
• Your characters should hold no more than two departmental jobs and one service side job. You may occasionally swap departments so long as it is not consistent and happens infrequently. 

• Permanent death is not required and is completely up to the player. Clone backups are created and stored at an off-site facility for the majority of the crew; however, a character may choose not to consent to this for any reason.
